comments.text: “Great rock trio” lists are heavily guitar mythology-driven. Piano led trios don’t fit the archetype. The people and critics who come up with these lists aren’t musicians. I’d bet if you polled the great musicians of that era, Elton’s trio would be right up there. Fascinating contrast in styles. Elton’s piano is a leading instrument. In the Stones version, Nicky Hopkins beautifully understated piano is barely noticeable (very intentional), but absolutely essential in anchoring the harmonic rhythm.
comments.author: @GoneButNotGone
